purpose.en: Complete independent ready parts of the active milestone.
purpose.zh: 并行完成当前里程碑内已就绪的独立部分。

entry.en: Stable interfaces and non-overlapping write scopes
entry.zh: 接口和写入边界已确定

exit.en: Every assigned requirement is implemented with focused engineering evidence.
exit.zh: 分配的需求实现完整，并有定向工程证据。

failure.en: Coordinate interface changes with the integrator and all consumers.
failure.zh: 接口变化由集成人协调所有受影响的使用方。

boundary.en: One owner writes shared files; waiting is observation, not a task timeout.
boundary.zh: 共享文件由单一负责人写入；观察窗口不是任务终止期限。
